title: ProxyPolicy
description: Machine checkable form of the proxy masking policy, docs/04-contracts/proxy-policy.md. The file an operator edits is policy.toml; this schema describes its canonical JSON projection, which is what the loader validates after parsing and what CI validates in schemas/examples. THIS IS NOT policy.schema.json. That file is the PASS/WARN/FAIL verdict policy of the report pipeline (docs/04-contracts/policy-schema.md) and shares nothing with this one but the word policy: different $id, different fields, different owner, different failure mode. Neither file supersedes the other and neither may be extended to cover the other's concept.

entity_type.description: Closed set. An unrecognized type identifier stops the load rather than being ignored: a silently dropped rule sends data the operator believes is masked. Spelling is UPPER_SNAKE, which is the one documented exception to the snake_case enum rule, because the identifier also appears inside the alias itself (PSK_TCKN_..., PERSON_1) and ADR-010 section 5.2 fixes that table.

mode.description: allow means no masking. It does not mean no record: every entity that crosses under allow is counted in entities_allowed of the ProxyEvent.

rule.description: Field scoped rules. Narrowest scope wins; at equal narrowness block beats mask beats allow. The ordering is conservative and cannot be relaxed by a new key.

scope.description: JSON path into the request body. Absent means every scanned field.

alias_style.description: Default type-preserving. opaque drops every type to rung O of the ADR-010 ladder. P-0 holds in both styles.

date_policy.description: Default allow. shift is a valid value of this contract and is NOT implemented in the F4 build: a policy that asks for it fails the load with a distinguishable message rather than falling back to allow. See proxy-policy.md section 7.

derived_date_action.description: Meaningful only under date_policy = shift. There is no ignore value and none may be added: a derived date silently off by delta is wrong data delivered to the user.

on_hold_timeout.description: Default flush, which trades a possible unmasked alias fragment for latency and counts it in partial_alias_flushed. wait trades latency for the masking guarantee. There is no third option that flushes without counting.

code_block_policy.description: Default pattern-only: inside fenced code blocks only the deterministic pattern layer runs.

tool_call_policy.description: What happens to structured tool call and tool result arguments, which F4 does not mask. Default pass-through: the arguments cross unmasked and the gap is declared loudly (x-periskop-degraded header, degraded_reasons entry, unmasked_passthrough finding). reject refuses the request instead. Silent pass-through is not one of the values.

enabled.description: Default false. true is a valid value of this contract and is NOT implemented in the F4 build; the loader stops with a distinguishable message. masking_profile is derived from this key and is never written directly.

l_max_session.description: Never above L_MAX_STATIC. A configuration that exceeds it is rejected: the lookahead window is a correctness bound, not a tuning knob.

dictionary.description: Where layer B loads the organization word list from. The list itself is not inlined here: policy files get copied, reviewed and committed, and an inline list would put the very names this component exists to protect into a plaintext file that travels.

source.description: Path to the dictionary file, resolved relative to the policy file. Contract: proxy-dictionary.schema.json.

required.description: Default true. When true a missing or unreadable dictionary stops startup. When false the proxy starts with layer B empty and declares degraded_reasons = dictionary_unavailable on every request; it never starts silently without the list.

affix_rules.description: Language specific affix aware matching for layer B, which is what lets Ahmet in the dictionary match Ahmet'in. Directory contract: rules/masking/<lang>/, deliberately not rules/<lang>/, which holds static scanner detector rules in a different rule language.

languages.description: Closed set. A language listed here must have a rules/masking/<lang>/ directory; a listed language with no rule directory stops the load rather than matching without affix handling, because the difference is silent under-masking.
